description: This file defines the SchedulerDAO interface which specifies methods for managing scheduled tasks in a database, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting tasks.

classes.name: SchedulerDAO
classes.description: Interface providing database operations related to scheduler tasks, such as creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting tasks.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Creates a new scheduled task in the database.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its internal identifier.

methods.name: getTaskByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its UUID.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task in the database.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks from the database.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a specified task from the database.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task identified by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getTaskByName
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its public name.
